AddTwoWayBikeLane(w_broad_st_northeast, left): 8 ft two-way lane, 3 ft buffer. Spends 11.82 ft of this leg's 32.07 ft between kerbs, leaving two 10.13 ft travel lanes with the centreline shifted 5.88 ft toward the right kerb - under the 11 ft target by 0.87 ft, which is this leg's width rather than a choice, so the travel way is split equally. The NJDOT alignment does not move; every station and crossing frame is measured from it as before. NOTE: NJDOT's Bicycle Compatible Roadways and Bikeways (1996) calls a two-way bike lane on one side of the roadway 'unacceptable'; that guidance predates separated bikeways and MUTCD 11th ed. 9E.06 now marks them, but the departure has to be argued, not assumed - see STANDARDS.md 4.

AddBikeLaneBollards(w_broad_st_northeast, left): flex-post delineators at 8 ft in the 3 ft buffer between the travel lane and the bike lane - the traffic side, which is the side that needs protecting.
